# Test fonts

Modified subsets of two SIL Open Font License 1.1 fonts, rebuilt by `build.py` (see its header
for the source files, the exact modifications and how to run it). Each family's license sits
beside its files.

| File | Font | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fraunces/Fraunces-Roman-VF.ttf` | Fraunces, variable (`opsz`, `wght`, `SOFT`, `WONK`) | TTF |
| `fraunces/Fraunces-Italic-VF.woff2` | Fraunces Italic, variable | WOFF2 |
| `space-grotesk/SpaceGrotesk-Bold.woff` | Space Grotesk, static Bold instance | WOFF |

They are test data only and are not published with the package.
